enable_debug.description: Turn on debugging output. Note that this may reveal sensitive information.

no_global_grab.description: Grab the keyboard only when the window is focused.

parent_wid.description: Window ID N to use as the parent window for positioning.

display.description: STRING to pass as the X11 display.

ttyname.description: STRING to pass as the tty name.

lc_ctype.description: STRING to pass as the LC_CTYPE locale setting.

lc_messages.description: STRING to pass as the LC_MESSAGES locale setting.
